data.title: Power is back

description: The Solix C2000 is the office UPS. Grid input gone while it still feeds a load = power cut: one push, marked in input_boolean.power_cut_announced (+ power_cut_since), then one 'power is back' when the input returns. Marker + trigger, not a wait, so a restart mid-cut loses nothing (review #48). Battery under 20 % for 5 min with no grid: warn. Unreachable is never a cut and never 'back'. If the push fails, nobody else is told.
